privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.lead: This policy explains how WATAD Software («WATAD», «we») collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects personal data when you visit watadiq.com, communicate with us, or engage our web, mobile, and cybersecurity services.
privacyPage.manageCookiesHint: You can reopen the cookie banner and change your choices at any time.

cookieRows.purpose: Site security, language, session, cookie consent storage.
Understand traffic and improve pages (only if you allow).
Measure campaigns and show relevant offers (only if you allow).

intro.title: Introduction
paragraphs: We respect your privacy and aim to be transparent about the data we process. This Privacy Policy («Policy») describes how WATAD Software («WATAD», «we», «us») handles personal information when you visit https://www.watadiq.com, use our contact forms, communicate with us, or engage our professional services.

This Policy applies to visitors, prospective clients, active clients, and anyone who interacts with our website, email, or project delivery channels. It does not replace a signed data processing agreement where one is required for a specific project.

By using our website or services, you acknowledge that you have read this Policy. Where the law requires consent—for example for non-essential cookies or certain marketing—we ask for your choice before enabling those features.

We design our products with security and privacy in mind, but no online service can guarantee absolute security. We encourage you to use strong passwords, keep your devices updated, and contact us if you notice suspicious activity related to your account or project.
If you do not agree with this Policy, please discontinue use of our website and services, except where we must retain certain records for legal or contractual reasons.

This Policy is designed to meet expectations of international clients while reflecting how we operate from Iraq. It should be read together with our Terms of Service and any project-specific data addendum.
We publish this document in Arabic and English. If translations differ, we work in good faith to align them; contact us if you need clarification for compliance reviews.

controller.title: Data controller
paragraphs: WATAD Software is the data controller for personal data described in this Policy, unless we explicitly state that we act as a processor on behalf of a client.
For general privacy inquiries, contact: info@watadiq.com. Website: https://www.watadiq.com

When we deliver websites, apps, or infrastructure for clients, those clients may be controllers of their end users' data. In those cases, their privacy policy governs end-user relationships, and we process data according to our contract with the client.
We may appoint internal owners for privacy and security matters and work with legal counsel when updating this Policy or responding to regulatory requests.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.lead: We collect only what we need to operate watadiq.com, respond to you, deliver services, and improve our work. Categories include:
bullets: Identity & contact: name, email, phone, company name, job title, and messages you send via forms or email.
Usage data: pages viewed, time on page, scroll depth (aggregated), referral URL, and general device/browser information.
Technical data: IP address (often truncated or processed via CDN), user agent, language preference, and approximate region derived from network data.
Cookie & consent records: your cookie banner choices stored in local storage or similar technologies on your device.
Project & billing data: statements of work, invoices, payment references, and communication history related to active engagements.
Support content: files, screenshots, or credentials you voluntarily share so we can troubleshoot or deliver work (handled under confidentiality terms).
Marketing preferences: whether you opted in to newsletters or promotional messages, and proof of consent where required.
Security logs: failed login attempts, rate-limit events, and abuse signals used to protect our infrastructure.
Aggregated analytics: statistics that do not identify you personally, used to improve performance and content.
Social & campaign parameters: UTM tags or similar parameters when you arrive from ads or social links (if analytics cookies are allowed).
paragraphs: We do not intentionally collect sensitive categories such as health, biometric, or government ID data through the public website. If a project requires such data, we address it in a separate agreement.
You may choose not to provide certain information, but we may be unable to respond to inquiries or deliver services without sufficient contact and project details.
We minimize collection: we do not ask for government ID on the marketing site, and we discourage sending passwords in plain email—use agreed secure channels for credentials during projects.

cookies.title: Cookies & similar technologies
cookies.lead: We use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies to run the site, remember language, keep you signed in where applicable, and—only with permission—measure analytics or marketing performance.
paragraphs: Essential technologies are always active because core features (security, language, consent storage) cannot work without them.
Optional analytics help us understand which pages are useful and where visitors drop off. Optional marketing cookies may help measure campaigns; we enable them only if you consent.
You can change preferences anytime via the cookie banner or the manage-cookies control at the bottom of this page. Browser settings may also block cookies, though some features may stop working.
Third-party embeds (for example video players or maps) may set their own cookies if you interact with them; their policies apply to that processing.
You may use browser controls to block cookies; essential site features may degrade. We honor Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals where technically feasible for optional analytics.

legal.title: Legal bases for processing
legal.lead: Depending on your location and the activity, we rely on one or more of the following bases:
bullets: Contract: delivering proposals, projects, hosting, maintenance, and support you request.
Legitimate interests: securing platforms, preventing fraud and abuse, improving products, and understanding aggregated usage.
Consent: non-essential cookies, optional newsletters, and certain marketing communications.
Legal obligation: tax, accounting, responding to lawful requests, and regulatory compliance.
Vital interests: rare situations where processing is necessary to protect someone's safety.
Pre-contract steps: responding to quotes and preparing agreements at your request.
paragraphs: Where we rely on legitimate interests, we balance our needs against your rights and implement safeguards such as minimization and access controls.
You may withdraw consent at any time for processing that depends on it; withdrawal does not affect processing that occurred before withdrawal where it was lawful.

use.title: How we use your information
bullets: Provide, operate, and maintain watadiq.com and related tools.
Respond to contact, sales, and support requests.
Prepare proposals, statements of work, and project documentation.
Deliver design, development, security, and hosting services under contract.
Process payments and send invoices or receipts.
Send service-related notices (for example maintenance windows or policy updates).
Analyze aggregated traffic to improve speed, accessibility, and content (with consent where required).
Detect, investigate, and prevent security incidents and abuse.
Enforce our Terms of Service and protect our rights and users.
Comply with applicable laws and respond to valid legal process.
paragraphs: We do not use your personal data for automated decision-making that produces legal or similarly significant effects without appropriate safeguards and notice where required.
Marketing emails are sent only when permitted by law and your preferences; every marketing message includes a way to opt out where applicable.

sharing.title: Sharing & processors
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal data. We do not share it for third-party advertising lists.

We disclose data to service providers («processors») who help us operate—for example cloud hosting, CDN/WAF, email delivery, analytics (if consented), payment processors, and collaboration tools—under contracts that require confidentiality and appropriate security.
We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or governmental request, or when we believe disclosure is necessary to protect rights, safety, or investigate fraud.
If WATAD undergoes a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, personal data may transfer as part of that transaction with notice where required by law.
bullets: Hosting & CDN partners in regions we select for performance and security.
Email and transactional messaging providers.
Analytics providers only when you allow analytics cookies.
Professional advisers (lawyers, accountants) under confidentiality.
Subcontractors assisting on your project, bound by confidentiality and need-to-know access.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.lead: We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purposes described in this Policy:
bullets: Contact form and sales inquiries: typically up to 24 months unless a project starts or law requires longer.
Active client project files: for the project duration plus a reasonable archive period (often 3–7 years for business records).
Invoices and payment records: as required by tax and accounting rules.
Cookie consent choices: stored on your device until you clear storage or change preferences.
Security logs: generally 30–365 days depending on severity and investigation needs.
Marketing lists: until you unsubscribe or we retire the campaign, plus a suppression record to honor opt-out.
Backups: may persist for a limited period after deletion from live systems before being overwritten.
Legal holds: longer retention when disputes, audits, or investigations require it.
paragraphs: When data is no longer needed, we delete or anonymize it where feasible. Anonymized statistics may be retained indefinitely.

security.title: Security
paragraphs: We use HTTPS/TLS encryption in transit, hardened hosting, access controls, rate limiting, and monitoring appropriate to our size and risk profile.
Project credentials and secrets you share are stored with least-privilege access and are not used beyond delivering your engagement.
We review dependencies and apply patches on a reasonable schedule; client production environments may follow separate maintenance agreements.
No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure. If we become aware of a breach affecting your personal data, we will notify you and regulators as required by law.
We maintain incident response playbooks, restrict production access, and review vendor security periodically. Clients may request a summary of controls relevant to their project under NDA.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.lead: Depending on applicable law (including GDPR-style rights where relevant), you may have the following:
bullets: Access: request a copy of personal data we hold about you.
Correction: ask us to fix inaccurate or incomplete data.
Deletion: request erasure where no overriding legal basis requires retention.
Restriction: ask us to limit processing in certain circumstances.
Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing.
Portability: receive data you provided in a structured, commonly used format where technically feasible.
Withdraw consent: for processing that relies on consent, without affecting prior lawful processing.
Complaint: lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in your country or region.
Opt out of marketing: use unsubscribe links or contact us directly.
Cookie controls: change optional cookie categories at any time.
rights.note: To exercise rights, email info@watadiq.com with enough detail for us to verify your identity and locate your records. We respond within timelines required by applicable law.
paragraphs: We may decline requests that are manifestly unfounded, repetitive, or would impair others' rights. We may charge a reasonable fee where permitted for excessive requests.
For EU/UK visitors, we aim to respect applicable GDPR-style rights even when Iraq is our primary jurisdiction. Response times follow reasonable industry practice unless law sets a shorter deadline.

children.title: Children
paragraphs: Our website and agency services are directed at businesses and adults. They are not directed at children under 16.
We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child provided data to us, contact info@watadiq.com and we will take appropriate steps to delete it.
Clients who build products for children must comply with applicable child privacy laws in their jurisdictions; that compliance is the client's responsibility unless agreed otherwise in writing.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Policy when our practices, technologies, or legal requirements change. The «Last updated» date at the top of this page indicates the latest revision.
Material changes may be highlighted on our website or communicated to active clients where appropriate.
Continued use of the website after changes become effective means you accept the updated Policy, except where further consent is required by law.

contact.title: Contact us
paragraphs: Questions about this Policy, cookies, or your personal data:
We aim to respond to privacy requests within a reasonable time and in any event within deadlines required by applicable law.

definitions.title: Definitions
bullets: «Personal data»: information relating to an identified or identifiable individual.
«Processing»: any operation on personal data (collection, storage, use, disclosure, deletion).
«Controller»: entity that decides why and how personal data is processed (usually WATAD for watadiq.com operations).
«Processor»: entity processing data on behalf of a controller (hosting, email, analytics vendors).
«Cookies»: small text files stored on your device; «local storage» includes similar browser storage APIs.
paragraphs: Project-specific definitions may appear in your statement of work or data processing addendum.

international.title: International transfers
paragraphs: Our infrastructure and subprocessors may process data in countries other than your own (for example cloud regions in Europe, the United States, or the Middle East).
When we transfer personal data internationally, we use appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses, vendor certifications, or your written instructions in project contracts.
You may request information about primary processing locations for your project by contacting info@watadiq.com.

marketing.title: Marketing communications
paragraphs: We may send newsletters or service updates if you opt in or if we have another lawful basis under applicable law.
Every marketing email includes an unsubscribe link or instructions. Transactional messages (invoices, project updates you requested) are not marketing.
We do not sell your email address to list brokers.

termsPage.lead: These terms govern your use of watadiq.com and all professional services offered by WATAD Software. They describe eligibility, project delivery, fees, intellectual property, liability, and how we resolve disputes.

These Terms form a binding agreement between you (or the organization you represent) and WATAD. You represent that you have authority to bind that organization when acting on its behalf.
Where a signed statement of work, master services agreement, proposal, or invoice terms conflict with these Terms, the signed or written project agreement prevails for that specific engagement.
We may provide translations of these Terms for convenience; the English version controls if there is a conflict unless local law requires otherwise.
These Terms are a general framework. Enterprise clients may negotiate master service agreements with additional security, insurance, or SLA commitments.

services.title: Our services
services.lead: WATAD is an Iraqi digital agency. Services include, without limitation:
bullets: Custom website design and development (marketing sites, dashboards, e-commerce, web apps).
Mobile application design and development for iOS and Android.
UI/UX design, design systems, and brand-aligned product interfaces.
Cybersecurity assessments, hardening guidance, secure architecture reviews, and related consulting.
Cloud deployment, DevOps support, hosting setup, and ongoing maintenance retainers.
API integrations, third-party service wiring, and performance optimization.
Training, documentation, and handover sessions for client teams where agreed.
Emergency support or remediation when contracted separately.
paragraphs: Detailed scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, and fees appear in your proposal, invoice, or signed agreement. We may update public service descriptions on watadiq.com without altering active contracts.
Beta features, internal tools, or experimental offerings may be labeled as such and provided without the same warranties as paid deliverables unless agreed in writing.

bullets: You must be at least 18 years old or have legal authority to enter contracts for your organization.
Information you provide must be accurate and kept up to date.
You are responsible for credentials, API keys, domains, and access you share with us.

If we offer client portals or project accounts, you must notify us immediately of unauthorized access.
paragraphs: We may refuse or terminate service to anyone who violates these Terms or poses a risk to our team, infrastructure, or other clients.

projects.title: Projects & deliverables
bullets: Timelines depend on agreed scope, your timely feedback, and materials you supply (copy, brand assets, approvals).
Change requests outside scope may require a change order, revised fees, or new delivery dates.
We may use vetted subcontractors under confidentiality and need-to-know access.
You will designate a primary contact with authority to approve scope and deliverables.
Review periods for designs, staging sites, or builds are defined in your agreement; silence after the review window may count as acceptance where stated.
Third-party licenses (fonts, stock media, plugins, SaaS) may require your separate acceptance or payment.
Launch dates may depend on DNS, app store review, payment gateways, or other third parties outside our control.
projects.note: Delays caused by missing content, unavailable stakeholders, third-party outages, or force majeure extend schedules without penalty to WATAD.
paragraphs: We document major decisions in writing (email or project tools) to keep a clear record for both parties.
Post-launch warranty periods for bug fixes—if any—are defined in your agreement; new features are out of scope unless quoted.

payment.title: Fees & payment
bullets: Quotes are typically in Iraqi Dinar (IQD) unless another currency is stated in writing.
Accepted methods may include bank transfer, Zain Cash, or other channels published on our pricing page.
Deposits and milestone invoices are due on the dates shown; work may pause when accounts are overdue.
Late payments may incur reminders, suspension of work, or interest where permitted by law and stated on invoices.
Deposits and completed milestone work are generally non-refundable once work has started, except where law or your agreement says otherwise.
You are responsible for bank fees, currency conversion, and transfer charges on your side unless we agree otherwise.
Disputed invoices must be raised in writing within 14 days of receipt with specific reasons; undisputed portions remain due.
paragraphs: Excluded unless explicitly included: government fees, domain renewals, SSL where billed separately, ad spend, stock licenses, app store fees, SMS/voice costs, and pass-through SaaS subscriptions.
Taxes: you are responsible for applicable taxes unless we state we collect them on invoices.
Recurring retainers renew monthly or annually as stated on your invoice until cancelled per agreement notice periods.

ip.title: Intellectual property
bullets: Upon full payment of agreed fees, you receive the license or ownership rights specified in your project contract to final deliverables created specifically for you.
WATAD retains ownership of pre-existing code libraries, internal tools, boilerplate, methodologies, and general know-how used to perform the work.
We grant you a license to any WATAD background IP embedded in deliverables as needed to use the deliverables as intended.
You may not resell our proprietary tools or reuse our internal templates outside the licensed deliverables without permission.
Portfolio: unless you object in writing before public launch, we may display non-confidential visuals and project descriptions in our portfolio and marketing.
You warrant that content you supply does not infringe trademarks, copyrights, privacy, or publicity rights of third parties.
Open-source components in deliverables remain subject to their licenses; we will flag major OSS dependencies when practical.
paragraphs: If you terminate early, rights to incomplete work are handled as stated in your agreement; otherwise WATAD may retain unfinished materials until outstanding fees are settled.

client.title: Your responsibilities
bullets: Provide timely feedback, approvals, and required content in agreed formats.
Ensure legal rights to logos, fonts, product data, user lists, and media you provide.
Maintain backups of live environments when we are not under a maintenance contract.
Comply with data protection laws for your end users; publish your own privacy policy where required.
Configure DNS, app store accounts, and merchant accounts promptly when those are on your side.
Do not ask us to implement deceptive patterns, illegal tracking, or malware.
Inform us of accessibility, language, or regulatory requirements before build starts when they affect architecture.
paragraphs: You indemnify WATAD against third-party claims arising from materials you supply or unlawful use of deliverables, except to the extent caused by our gross negligence or willful misconduct.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
paragraphs: Each party agrees to protect non-public business, technical, pricing, and roadmap information received from the other party.
Confidential information excludes data that is public without breach, independently developed, or rightfully received from a third party without duty of confidentiality.
We may disclose confidential information to employees, contractors, and advisers who need it to perform services, under matching confidentiality obligations.
If required by law, a party may disclose confidential information after giving notice when legally permitted so the other party may seek protective measures.

warranties.title: Warranties & disclaimers
paragraphs: We will perform services with reasonable skill and care consistent with professional digital agencies in our category.

Except as expressly written in your signed agreement, watadiq.com and our services are provided «as is» and «as available» without warranties of uninterrupted uptime, error-free operation, or fitness for a particular business outcome.
We do not guarantee search rankings, revenue, conversion rates, viral growth, or specific security outcomes unless explicitly stated in a security services scope.
Third-party platforms (hosting, app stores, payment gateways) have their own terms and outages; we are not liable for their failures beyond our reasonable integration efforts.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including lost profits, lost data, or business interruption.

WATAD's total aggregate liability for claims relating to a project or these Terms is limited to the fees you paid WATAD for that project in the twelve (12) months before the event giving rise to the claim, unless a higher cap is signed in your agreement.
These limits apply regardless of theory of liability (contract, tort, negligence, strict liability, or otherwise).
You acknowledge that pricing reflects these limitations and that WATAD would not provide services at current rates without them.
Client acknowledges that software and security involve inherent risk; no vendor can guarantee zero vulnerabilities.
liability.note: Nothing limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law, including fraud, willful misconduct, or death/personal injury caused by negligence where non-waivable.

suspension.title: Suspension & termination
bullets: We may suspend website access, project work, or hosted environments if you breach these Terms, fail to pay, or misuse systems.
You may terminate according to cancellation terms in your signed agreement; otherwise written notice may be required with fees for work completed.
Upon termination, you pay for work performed, non-cancellable third-party costs, and any wind-down agreed in writing.
We may delete staging data after a reasonable period post-termination unless you purchase archive export.
Provisions that by nature should survive (payment, IP, confidentiality, liability limits, dispute resolution) remain in effect.
paragraphs: If you migrate away from WATAD-managed hosting, we will provide reasonable transition assistance when contracted; emergency handover may require additional fees.

governing.title: Governing law & disputes
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Iraq, without regard to conflict-of-law rules that would apply another jurisdiction's laws.

Parties will first attempt good-faith resolution through direct negotiation. If unresolved within 30 days, disputes may be submitted to the competent courts in Iraq unless your signed agreement specifies arbitration or another forum.
You agree to bring claims only in your individual capacity unless we agree otherwise in writing.
Nothing prevents either party from seeking injunctive relief for misuse of IP or confidentiality breaches in any court with jurisdiction.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms when services, regulations, or business practices change. The updated version will be posted here with a revised «Last updated» date.
Material changes affecting active clients will be handled through project agreements or direct notice where appropriate.
Continued use of watadiq.com after changes take effect constitutes acceptance unless further consent is required by law.

contact.title: Contact us
paragraphs: Questions about these Terms, billing, or an active project:
Legal & contracts: info@watadiq.com — we route your message to the appropriate team member.

acceptable.title: Acceptable use
bullets: Do not use deliverables to distribute malware, spam, or unlawful content.
Do not attempt unauthorized access to WATAD or client systems.
Do not misrepresent WATAD as the publisher of your end-user content.
Respect third-party platform rules (app stores, ad networks, payment providers).
paragraphs: We may report credible illegal activity to authorities when required or when necessary to protect victims.

sla.title: Support & SLA
paragraphs: Response times for bugs and incidents depend on your support tier in the signed agreement (business hours vs 24/7).
Unless an SLA is explicitly purchased, we do not guarantee specific uptime percentages for staging or internal tools.
Emergency security patches for WATAD-managed hosting are prioritized according to severity and contract.

forceMajeure.title: Force majeure
paragraphs: Neither party is liable for delay or failure caused by events beyond reasonable control (natural disasters, war, widespread outages, government actions, pandemics, major internet failures).
The affected party will notify the other and resume performance as soon as practicable.

about.title: About WATAD
about.intro: WATAD is an official Iraqi software agency focused on web development, mobile applications, cybersecurity, and digital products that help ambitious brands scale with confidence.

sections.title: Our story
paragraphs: WATAD was founded so Iraqi businesses and creators could access the same standard of digital craft found in leading global tech hubs. We unite precise design, dependable engineering, and security led thinking so every product we ship feels premium and holds up under real world pressure.
From startups launching a first app to established brands renewing their web presence, we stay close to clients and translate bold ideas into software that ships on schedule.

sections.title: Mission
paragraphs: Enable generations of Iraqi entrepreneurs, artists, and organizations to succeed, influence culture, and shape a stronger digital future, one product at a time.
list: Build fast, accessible, and beautiful digital experiences.
Protect what matters with modern cybersecurity practices.
Stay close to clients from strategy through launch and beyond.

securityPage.title: Security woven into every layer
securityPage.lead: WATAD Software provides security audits, penetration testing, and resilient architecture for websites and apps. Our work follows OWASP guidance and is tailored to Iraqi businesses that need trust, compliance, and calm at launch.
securityPage.heroImageAlt: Illustration of a security specialist with shield and secure infrastructure, WATAD Software
securityPage.pillarsLead: From code review to production monitoring, we protect the full stack your customers depend on.

pillars.title: Audits & penetration testing
pillars.text: We test the way attackers would, before they can. Manual and automated reviews across your web app, APIs, and admin surfaces.
bullets: OWASP Top 10 checklist
Authentication & session review
Written findings with severity levels
Remediation guidance for your team

pillars.title: Secure architecture
pillars.text: Security decisions made at design time cost less than fixes after launch. We design roles, secrets, and data flows correctly from day one.
bullets: Least-privilege access models
Encrypted data in transit & at rest
Backup & recovery planning
Cloud and hosting hardening

pillars.title: Monitoring & response
pillars.text: Launch is not the finish line. We help you watch traffic, logs, and alerts so issues are caught early.
bullets: Uptime & error monitoring setup
Security header configuration
Incident response playbook
Optional ongoing retainer
